title: King Brick Breaker
description: Master precision bank shots across hundreds of geometric brick fortresses—chain 50+ bouncing balls behind the top wall for pure visual bliss.
controls: Drag to aim your launch trajectory and release to fire a stream of balls that chip down numbered bricks.

zh-CN.title: 王者打砖块
zh-CN.description: 经典强迫症爽游王者打砖块：找准死角把几十颗弹球送上砖块上方疯狂连弹，清脆碎砖音效超级治愈！
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动虚线瞄准最佳反弹角度，松手齐射弹球串清空全场数字砖块。
